'''Margit Theresa Rätzsch''' (13 September 1934 - 15 August 2016<ref>Death notice in [[neues deutschland]], 3. September 2016, p. 6.</ref>) was a German [[chemist]].<ref name=":1">[http://unesdoc.unesco.org/images/0006/000689/068990EB.pdf UNESCO]</ref> She was rector at [[Technical University Leuna-Merseburg]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://zefys.staatsbibliothek-berlin.de/ddr-presse/ergebnisanzeige/?purl=SNP26120215-19811205-0-2-385-0|title=Neuer Rektor|date=5 December 1981|work=Berliner Zeitung}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundesstiftung-aufarbeitung.de/wer-war-wer-in-der-ddr-%2363%3B-1424.html?ID=2765|title=Rätzsch, Margit Theresa|language=de|access-date=15 December 2018}}</ref>

== Life ==
Rätzsch was born in [[Teplice|Teplice-Šanov]] in the [[Sudetenland]], then [[Czechoslovakia]] (now [[Czech Republic]]).<ref name=":0" />

She studied physics at the [[Leipzig University|University of Leipzig]] from 1952-1956. In 1959 she moved to the Technical University for Chemistry Leuna-Merseburg, where she held the position of scientific assistant and assistant to the Vice Rector for Research until 1964. It was in this year that she also received her [[doctorate]], enabling her to move immediately into a job as a senior assistant. She completed this phase of her work in 1968 with her [[habilitation]].<ref name=":0" />

Starting in 1969, she became a lecturer and then a professor of physical chemistry at the “[[Technical University Leuna-Merseburg|Carl Schorlemmer” Technical University in Leuna-Merseburg]]. In addition, she was appointed director of the process chemistry section. From 1981 to 1990, she was rector at the university.<ref name=":0" />

With the dismantling of the technical college on 31 March 1993, Rätzsch entered early retirement and continued to live in [[Merseburg]].<ref name=":0" />

In 1985, she chaired a five-day [[UNESCO]] meeting of 16 experts from 15 countries about "Participation of Women in Various Areas of Higher Education" held in [[Wrocław|Wroclaw, Poland]], in December.<ref name=":1" />

She died in [[Merseburg]] in 2016.

== Research ==
Rätzsch's research concentrated on [[physical chemistry]] and [[chemical thermodynamics]].<ref name=":0" />

== Selected publications ==

* ''Intermolecular interactions and structure in liquid non-electrolytes.'' Meeting reports of the Academy of Sciences of the GDR, born in 1978, No. 4 N: Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Technology. Akademie publishing house, Berlin 1978.
* ''Core effect in low-molecular fluid systems.'' Meeting reports of the Academy of Sciences of the GDR, born in 1978, No. 4 N: Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Technology. Akademie Verlag, Berlin 1978 (with Rainer Patz).
* ''Thermodynamics and biological development.'' Meeting reports of the Academy of Sciences of the GDR, born 1980, No. 2 N: mathematics, natural sciences, technology. Akademie publishing house, Berlin 1980.
* ''Proceedings / 6th [Sixth] International Conference on Thermodynamics.'' Merseburg, August 26–29, 1980 / Techn. Hochsch. Leuna-Merseburg, German Democrat. Republic. [Sponsored by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry . Organized by the Carl Schorlemmer Techn. Univ., Leuna-Merseburg in collab. with the Chem. Soc. of the German Democrat. Republic. Chairperson: Margit T. Rätzsch]. Publisher: Technical University, Leuna-Merseburg 1980.
* ''Continuous thermodynamics of multicomponent mixtures.'' Meeting reports of the Academy of Sciences of the GDR, born 1982, No. 13 N: mathematics, natural sciences, technology. Akademie Verlag, Berlin 1983 (with H. Kehlen).
* ''Continuous thermodynamics of copolymer systems.'' Meeting reports of the Academy of Sciences of the GDR, born 1990, No. 4 N: Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Technology. Akademie Verlag, Berlin 1983, {{ISBN|3-05-500848-0}} (with Christian Wohlfarth).

== Awards ==
Rätzsch received the following awards:
* [[National Prize of the German Democratic Republic]] in 1984<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://zefys.staatsbibliothek-berlin.de/ddr-presse/ergebnisanzeige/?purl=SNP2612273X-19841006-0-4-179-0|title=Hohe Auszeichnungen zum 35. Jahrestag der DDR|date=6 October 1984|work=Neue Zeit}}</ref>
*[[:de:August-Kekulé-Medaille|August Kekulé medal]] in 1987
* Member of the [[Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.bbaw.de/die-akademie/akademiegeschichte/mitglieder-historisch/alphabetische-sortierung|title=Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften|website=www.bbaw.de|language=de-de|access-date=2018-12-15|archive-date=2020-02-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200206095511/http://www.bbaw.de/die-akademie/akademiegeschichte/mitglieder-historisch/alphabetische-sortierung|url-status=dead}}</ref>
